title: Exeter/Bohn Calibration-Holdout Split Audit

decision.recommended_next_phase: Phase 3D.1B - Exeter/Bohn no-fit static R0 extraction and split lock

source.paper: Bohn et al., All-optical switching of an epsilon-near-zero plasmon resonance in indium tin oxide

calibration_candidates.notes: These are package-code constants, not yet an Eternity-locked calibration input.

secondary_lanes.reason: Experiment has fixed wavelength_1 = 1250 nm and no wavelength_1 == wavelength_2 rows.
Experiment has diagonal rows but only 150 diagonal pre-pump rows per table; notebook path includes signal-offset handling.

leakage_risks: Figure 2 notebook already compares Experiment and Static model.
Hard-coded dth, incident index, thickness, and Drude parameters must not be tuned after residual inspection.
Static holdout is reconstructed from pre-pump rows inside a nonlinear pump-probe experiment.
The package Fresnel code includes a small complex-index workaround that needs reproduction review before any strong claim.
Any vertical scaling, wavelength shifting, thickness tuning, angle-offset tuning, or Drude refit against Figure 2 reflection would invalidate calibrated promotion.
allowed_next: Extract Figure 1 optical constants into a frozen material input.
Extract Figure 2 TIR reference and pre-pump R0 into canonical artifacts.
Create a calibration_holdout_split that forbids Figure 2 reflection rows from fitting.
Run a no-fit package-constant reproduction and emit a conservative residual report.
forbidden_next: Do not mark this dataset calibrated_linear_evidence from this audit alone.
Do not tune material, thickness, angle, scaling, wavelength, or threshold values after inspecting Figure 2 residuals.
Do not use Figure 3/4 offsets or dynamic rows to rescue a failed Figure 2 static comparison.
Do not proceed to Phase 4 without a locked split, reconstructed holdout table, no-fit model run, threshold policy, residual report, and claim-status review.
